steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I've gained a general understanding of this Infected's behavioral patterns. Despite his now exceptional Infected state, his actions still obey some kind of law.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In regards to stimulatory measures, he possesses distinct methods of resolving stressors, which likely are leftovers of habitual thought from his previous human form.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mutations in his infected organs have emerged within this same line: control, as well as be controlled.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Violence's cyclical nature has no potential to be undermined. To force, as well as to be forced, beat upon their skin in cyclic fashion.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In following, I will attempt to eliminate the possibility he may, owing to his exceptional Infected status, have any negative effect whatsoever on other organisms.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will render his infected organs harmless, halt those organs' action, and destroy their basic function.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As a doctor, that is all I am required to do.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even if we set the entire district ablaze, it would only serve to further disperse what exceptional Originium crystal makeup has already arisen, and bring about even more exceptional infection in turn. This operation is necessary.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Once this series of tasks is complete, he can return to being a normal Infected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only, the mutation of his infected organs has already dealt irreversible damage to his bodily function. The rate and degree of infection of his various physiological systems can only accelerate from here on.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He is already terminal; in end-state. The world has already abandoned him.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is the fate left for him. The only thing the world has for every single Infected.

options: Is this the only method of treatment?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: From a medical perspective, yes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: However, even if I were to look past my position as a doctor, I still would not have any participation in any facet of administration beyond, regarding Reunion Infected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We don't have much time. Whether or not he can awaken from his coma hinges entirely on how his physiological condition fares following operation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Following the conclusion of the Chernobog core city operation, we'll be completely disavowing any relationship with the Reunion Movement.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is a necessary piece of that puzzle.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Put simply, the numerous lives this Infected's organs are tied to, and his own fate, are nothing to do with Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You can make some sort of choice.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The power to choose has always been in your hands, Doctor. The majority of the time, we've had no time to review the consequences of our choices, and nothing more.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But before you make a choice, you should clearly ascertain their outcomes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Should you regard him as an Infected patient? Or should you regard him as one of Reunion's past leaders?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you regard him as a microcosm of all the evil that runs riot across this land, is he a casualty, or a perpetrator?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Should you regard him as an inseparable part of some kind of violent regime, or should you regard him as the lamentable outcome of some hideous logic?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In reality, these identities are all fundamentally inseparable. But we don't have the capacity to accommodate them all.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Whether you let him run his own course in the core city, or regard him as the ringleader of the Infected violence and apply grave consequences to him in the name of present society, or perhaps take him as an acutely ill patient to proceed down a humanitarian path of treatment...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Whether rationally passing judgment and deciding life or death, or directly confronting your own cognition to issue judgment that exceeds our scope of authority, these are all things you can do.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Factually, he has already vanished from this land. Only you can decide his fate, whether fortune or misfortune.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Whether benevolent, or just, or fair, or resentful, or whether you'd like all four, or whether your decision has nothing to do with these words at all, it doesn't matter to me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I won't issue any evaluation on your choices. Even if I would, I wouldn't speak it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even if making choices for other people's fates is a ridiculous, laughable affair...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He's already made his choice.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What should be done next, hinges only on you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm only a doctor meeting the patient for the first time. But you are the Doctor who's fought against him numerous times.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your understanding should be deeper than mine. Do what you should do.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is to be your own verdict, and not mine.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Or perhaps, Dr. {@nickname}, you already settled on a choice long ago?
